Why it matters

Every day, the dark holds back potential

For a child without reliable light at home, a lamp can make evening study possible.

Households without reliable powercannot count on light for evening study.
Kerosene lampsadd smoke to indoor air in many rural homes.
Study time lostwhen there is no light after dark.

The workshop

One workshop. One afternoon. Light that lasts years.

No black-box donations. Just hands-on learning, visible impact, and a light your people helped create. Designed so anyone can build one, with no technical background needed.

1

Assemble

Your employees build working solar lamps with guidance from Liefern's expert trainers.

2

Test and charge

Participants are guided step by step to assemble, seal and test a working lamp.

3

Deliver

The completed lamps can be delivered to communities facing a shortage of reliable power.

1.5 to 2 hoursdepending on group size. Most people finish their lamp in 60 to 90 minutes.
50 to 100 peopleper group. Minimum 100 lamps.
